name: Bridget Klaus
description: As President, Bridget leads the chapter's overall vision and operations, working alongside the executive board to keep Mu Epsilon Delta focused on scholarship, service, and brotherhood.
highlights: Sets the chapter's strategic direction and goals each semester
Chairs executive board meetings and keeps every committee aligned
Represents Mu Epsilon Delta to University of Tampa administration and MED National
Mentors officers and steps in wherever the chapter needs support

name: Ariana Kumar
description: As Vice President of Chapter Operations, Ariana keeps the day-to-day machinery of the chapter running, from meeting logistics to internal processes.
highlights: Coordinates chapter meeting schedules, agendas, and logistics
Oversees internal record-keeping and chapter operating procedures
Works with committee chairs to keep initiatives on track
Steps in for the President when needed

name: Janki Shah
role: Vice President of Membership and Development
description: As Vice President of Membership and Development, Janki leads recruitment efforts and shapes the new-member experience from first interest through initiation.
highlights: Plans and runs formal recruitment events each semester
Guides new members through onboarding and new-member education
Tracks membership standing and chapter growth
Builds programming that develops brothers' leadership skills over time

name: Kayla Haufler
description: As VP of Internal Relations, Kayla focuses on the culture and cohesion of the chapter, making sure brothers stay connected to each other.
highlights: Plans brotherhood events and social programming
Serves as a point of contact for member concerns and conflict resolution
Helps new members integrate into chapter culture
Gathers feedback to strengthen chapter morale

name: Alexa Janca
description: As Chair of Event Coordination, Alexa plans and executes the chapter's events, from recruitment nights to service outings.
highlights: Books venues and manages logistics for chapter events
Builds event timelines and coordinates volunteers
Works with other chairs to align event calendars
Handles day-of execution so events run smoothly

name: Marco Caponi
description: As Chair of Clinical and Shadowing, Marco connects brothers with hands-on healthcare experience through shadowing and clinical opportunities.
highlights: Builds relationships with local providers and clinics for shadowing placements
Shares clinical and shadowing opportunities with the chapter
Advises brothers on gaining patient-facing experience for their applications
Tracks brothers' clinical hours and experiences

name: Crystal Malithuruthel
description: As Chair of Research, Crystal helps brothers find and pursue research opportunities that strengthen their pre-health applications.
highlights: Curates and shares research opportunities across UT and Tampa Bay
Connects brothers with faculty and lab openings
Hosts info sessions on getting started in research
Supports brothers through the research application process

name: Andrew Dabbs
description: As Volunteer Chair, Andrew organizes the chapter's service initiatives and keeps brothers engaged with the Tampa Bay community.
highlights: Plans and staffs regular volunteer events
Partners with local organizations to source service opportunities
Tracks chapter service hours
Encourages consistent, meaningful volunteer engagement

name: Stefani Andrews
role: VP of Outreach and External Relations
description: As VP of Outreach and External Relations, Stefani builds the chapter's relationships beyond campus, from partner organizations to the broader healthcare community.
highlights: Cultivates partnerships with outside organizations and healthcare professionals
Represents the chapter at external events and conferences
Coordinates with MED National on chapter initiatives
Identifies new outreach and collaboration opportunities

name: Robert Mansfield
description: As Street Team Project Leader, Robert leads the chapter's on-campus outreach efforts, spreading the word about MED and recruitment.
highlights: Organizes tabling and on-campus promotional events
Leads a team of brothers in outreach initiatives
Coordinates flyering and campus visibility campaigns
Tracks engagement from outreach efforts

name: Anna Nolan
description: As Chair of Brand Relations, Anna manages the chapter's public image and content, from social media to visual identity.
highlights: Runs the chapter's social media presence and content calendar
Designs graphics and promotional materials for events
Keeps the chapter's brand consistent across platforms
Highlights brothers' achievements publicly

name: Austin Leibowitz
description: As VP of Communications, Austin oversees how information flows across the chapter, from internal updates to outward-facing messaging.
highlights: Sends chapter-wide updates and announcements
Oversees the Chair of Communications and messaging strategy
Coordinates communication between committees
Ensures brothers stay informed on deadlines and events

name: Carla Sales
description: As Chair of Communications, Carla supports day-to-day messaging and keeps brothers up to date on chapter happenings.
highlights: Drafts and distributes weekly chapter updates
Manages group communication channels
Assists with event announcements and reminders
Works with the VP of Communications on messaging strategy

name: Shreya Mehta
description: As VP of Finance, Shreya manages the chapter's budget and dues, keeping MED financially healthy and transparent.
highlights: Manages the chapter budget and tracks expenses
Collects and processes member dues
Handles reimbursements for chapter purchases
Reports on the chapter's financial standing to the executive board

name: Sydney Nguyen
description: As Chair of Philanthropy, Sydney leads fundraising and awareness efforts for Gift of Life Bone Marrow Registry, MED's national philanthropy partner.
highlights: Plans fundraising events and donor drives
Educates the chapter on Gift of Life's mission
Tracks philanthropy participation and funds raised
Coordinates with Gift of Life on registry events

name: Dilan Kochhar
description: As Student Government Representative, Dilan is the chapter's liaison to UT Student Government, keeping MED connected and in good standing on campus.
highlights: Represents MED at Student Government meetings and votes
Keeps the chapter informed on Student Government policies and funding
Advocates for the chapter's interests on campus
Ensures MED stays compliant with Student Government requirements
